ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-pixel field punctuated by discrete, high-contrast circular and annular white clusters (rosettes) primarily distributed in the mid-to-lower sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees at the point of intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by jagged pixel peaks and valleys along the entire posterior boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, exhibiting a positive upward slope relative to the horizontal midline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 12 distinct circular or ring-shaped high-contrast clusters concentrated in the central and lower regions of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; distinct irregular pixel cluster at the distal tip of the right lobe indicating possible barnacle colonization or localized trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced irregular protrusion on the extreme trailing edge of the right lobe tip, appearing as a jagged dark mass against the water background.
